oliver_fin: Noticed ~60 invoices with duplicated platform_fee line after today's billing run. Net revenue looks off.

mira_recon: Example INV-2026-1988 shows two $2.00 platform_fee lines; Stripe charge has only one application_fee_amount.

oliver_fin: Possible webhook replay + race where we ack before persisting event id.

mira_recon: We currently dedupe on charge_id. Need to dedupe on stripe_event_id too. Quick query to find duplicates:

```sql
SELECT charge_id, application_fee_cents, COUNT(*) cnt, array_agg(id) ids
FROM invoice_fee_lines
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '3 days'
GROUP BY charge_id, application_fee_cents
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```

jay_eng: I'll push a hotfix: persist stripe_event_id and return 200 only after it's recorded, plus add unique index on (stripe_event_id, fee_type). ETA ~1h for PR+deploy. Will also add an integration test that replays identical signed payloads.

sara_accounting: Finance needs a CSV of affected invoices with invoice id, fee amount, original NetSuite JE id (if posted). We'll hold NetSuite postings until cleanup is approved.

ops-bot: Command received: pause job netsuite_sync and pause job nightly_billing. Jobs paused by ops-bot at 2026-03-26T02:05:12Z.

mira_recon: I'll run the discovery query and attach the CSV here in ~25m. Tagging FIN-835 for the fix + FIN-836 for reversals.

oliver_fin: Thanks. Once hotfix is live and CSV validated, finance will prepare reversal JEs and sign-off to resume sync. :white_check_mark:
